# Broken fixtures

Hand-written `.s`/`.block` scripts, each deliberately containing one (or, for one
fixture, more than one) structural defect from the six required diagnostic
categories (FR-025). Same sourcing caveat as `../valid/README.md`: these are
structurally-representative, not verbatim third-party content, pending the real
fixture corpus's sourcing/licensing resolution (research.md §3, tasks.md T049).
